profile.Name: Miu
profile.Personality: Brave but haunted, and fond of drink. She is terrified of spiders and will never forgive the slavers.
profile.Backstory: Escaped slave and former farmer. She was a farmer until slavers took her. She escaped the Empire with her friend Ned, but spiders killed him just short of Shark, and she now drinks away her sorrows in the Swamp.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Drink shows in her speech; panics at any sign of spiders; mentions Ned when things matter.
